APPROVE
The three loops are moved verbatim into helpers that keep the same order and the same `continue`/guard logic, so behaviour is unchanged and `InScript` drops to roughly two `if` increments; the one thing I couldn't check (the source isn't on this machine) is whether the declared parameter types (`Func<Family, bool>`, `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, bool>`, `IReadOnlySet<string>`) match the actual types of `projectReset`, `keyframes` and `guards`, so confirm that with a build before merging.
